checklist.name: Identifies two layers

checklist.name: Workspace-level settings go to project.json

checklist.name: Build-level settings stay in vite.config.ts

checklist.name: Sections are intentional
checklist.description: The skeleton has separate sections for `plugins`, `build`, `server` and `test`.

checklist.name: Ad-hoc overrides removed or justified

checklist.name: Each step validated
